weight.description: Percentage this type contributes to the subject score

teachingAssignmentId.description: The class and subject these weights apply to

weights.description: The complete set. Types left out contribute nothing. The listed weights must total 100.

totalAverage.description: null when the card exists but has no scored subjects yet

classroomId.description: Classroom whose active enrolments are graded

semesterId.description: Semester the report cards belong to

skipped.description: Enrolments left alone because their card is published

skippedEnrollmentIds.description: Enrolment ids whose card was left published and untouched

isWeeklyHoliday.description: Whether today is one of the school's weekly holidays, so an empty timetable can say why it is empty.

classroomCode.description: The class being taught. Present on an employee’s row.

employeeName.description: Who takes the lesson. Present on a student’s row.

maxScore.description: The maximum this assessment is marked out of. Sent because a score is meaningless without it: 40 out of 50 is not a failing 40.

classroom.description: Null between years, when no enrolment exists for the active semester.

latestReportCard.description: The most recent published report card. An unpublished one is a draft the school has not handed over, and is never returned here.

supervisedClassrooms.description: Classes this employee is wali kelas for. Usually empty.

ungradedAssessments.description: The first few outstanding assessments, for the panel.

ungradedTotal.description: How many assessments are outstanding in total, so a panel showing five is never read as five remaining.

semester.description: The active semester, or null between years.

student.description: Null when the caller has no student record.

employee.description: Null when the caller has no employee record.
